arguments.statement: select aa.id as application_id, aa.status, aa.original_status, aa.account_type, aa.product, aa.created_at, aa.final_decisioned_at, aa.manual_review_mailers_sent_at, aa.send_manual_review_reminders_on, pa.id as person_application_id, pa.user_id, pa.kyc_status, pa.initial_kyc_status, pa.kyc_journey_status, pa.awaiting_documentation, pa.kyced_at from "rds.account_applications" aa join "rds.account_person_applications" apa on apa.account_application_id = aa.id join "rds.person_applications" pa on pa.id = apa.person_application_id where aa.id = 32855 order by pa.id

select cast(final_decisioned_at as date) as decision_date, status, count(*) as n from "rds.account_applications" where original_status='manual_review' and account_type='joint' and created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' and created_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' group by 1, 2 order by n desc

with c as (select * from "rds.account_applications" where original_status='manual_review' and account_type='joint' and created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' and created_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'), sw as (select * from c where status='rejected' and cast(final_decisioned_at as date) = DATE '2025-04-09'), pl as (select sw.id as aid, pa.kyc_status from sw join "rds.account_person_applications" apa on apa.account_application_id = sw.id join "rds.person_applications" pa on pa.id = apa.person_application_id) select (select count(*) from c) as cohort_size, (select count(*) from sw) as aged_out, (select count(*) from c where status in ('approved','rejected') and cast(final_decisioned_at as date) <> DATE '2025-04-09') as resolved_before_sweep, (select count(*) from c where status='manual_review') as still_manual_review, (select count(*) from pl where kyc_status='manual_review') as unresolved_person_kyc, (select count(*) from (select aid from pl where kyc_status='manual_review' group by aid having count(*) = 2) x) as both_applicants_unresolved, (select datediff('day', cast(created_at as date), cast(final_decisioned_at as date)) from "rds.account_applications" where id = 32855) as days_in_manual_review

with sw as (select * from "rds.account_applications" where original_status='manual_review' and account_type='joint' and created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' and created_at < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01' and status='rejected' and cast(final_decisioned_at as date) = DATE '2025-04-09') select sum(case when pa.kyc_status='manual_review' then 1 else 0 end) as applicants_unresolved, sum(case when pa.kyc_status='denied' then 1 else 0 end) as applicants_denied, count(*) as applicants_total from sw join "rds.account_person_applications" apa on apa.account_application_id = sw.id join "rds.person_applications" pa on pa.id = apa.person_application_id group by sw.id order by applicants_unresolved desc
